question_text: Karin maganar Hausa 'Karya ta fi gaskiya zama' tana nufin:
option_c: Lies are more common than truth
explanation: Karin maganar 'Karya ta fi gaskiya zama' tana nufin ƙarya ta fi gaskiya yawa.

question_text: Kalmar Hausa 'Maza' tana nufin:
explanation: Kalmar 'Maza' tana nufin 'men' a Turanci. Mata=women, Yara=children, Dattawa=elders.

question_text: A cikin nahawun Hausa, 'Sun tafi' tana nufin:
explanation: 'Sun tafi' tana nufin 'they went' a Turanci (third person plural past tense).

question_text: A tarihin Hausa, wace birni ce ake kira 'Birnin Katsina'?
explanation: A tarihin Hausa, birnin Katsina ne ake kira 'Birnin Katsina'.

question_text: A cikin rubutun Hausa, wane ne ya fara rubuta Hausa da rubutun Boko?
explanation: A cikin rubutun Hausa, turawan mishan ne suka fara rubuta Hausa da rubutun Boko (Latin).

question_text: Kalmar Hausa 'Yarinya' tana nufin:
explanation: Kalmar 'Yarinya' tana nufin 'girl' a Turanci. Yaro=boy, Mace=woman, Namiji=man.

question_text: A cikin al'adun Hausa, 'Wasan Kama' wasa ne na:
explanation: 'Wasan Kama' a cikin al'adun Hausa wasa ne na yara da suke yi don nishaɗi.

question_text: A tarihin Hausa, wane ne sarkin Zazzau da ya yi fada da Kanta?
explanation: A tarihin Hausa, Sarauniya Amina ta Zazzau ce ta yi fada da Sarki Kanta na Gobir.

question_text: Karin maganar Hausa 'Zomo da kura ba su gudu ba' tana nufin:
option_a: The hare and the hyena are friends
option_c: Everyone runs at their own pace
explanation: Karin maganar 'Zomo da kura ba su gudu ba' tana nufin mutane daban-daban suna da iyawa daban-daban.

question_text: Kalmar Hausa 'Dattijo' tana nufin:
explanation: Kalmar 'Dattijo' tana nufin 'elder' a Turanci. Saurayi=young person, Yaro=child, Mace=woman.

question_text: A cikin nahawun Hausa, 'Za mu tafi' tana nufin:
explanation: 'Za mu tafi' tana nufin 'we will go' a Turanci (first person plural future tense).

question_text: A tarihin Hausa, wane ne ya kafa birnin Daura?
explanation: A tarihin Hausa, Bayajidda ne ya kafa birnin Daura bayan ya kashe macijin Sarki.

question_text: A cikin rubutun Hausa, wace irin rubutu ce ake amfani da ita a addinin Musulunci?
explanation: A cikin rubutun Hausa, ana amfani da rubutun Ajami (Larabci) a addinin Musulunci don rubuta Hausa.

question_text: Kalmar Hausa 'Rana' tana nufin:
explanation: Kalmar 'Rana' tana nufin 'sun' a Turanci. Wata=moon, Tauraro=star, Gajimare=cloud.

question_text: A cikin al'adun Hausa, 'Hawan Sallah' bikin ne na:
explanation: 'Hawan Sallah' a cikin al'adun Hausa bikin Sallar Eid (Eid al-Fitr ko Eid al-Adha) ne.

question_text: A tarihin Hausa, wace birni ce ake kira 'Birnin Bayajidda'?
explanation: A tarihin Hausa, ana kiran birnin Daura da 'Birnin Bayajidda' bayan wanda ya kafa ta.

question_text: Karin maganar Hausa 'Hankali da jakunkuna ba su da iyaka' tana nufin:
explanation: Karin maganar 'Hankali da jakunkuna ba su da iyaka' tana nufin hankali bashi da iyaka.

question_text: Kalmar Hausa 'Mace' tana nufin:
explanation: Kalmar 'Mace' tana nufin 'woman' a Turanci. Namiji=man, Yaro=boy, Yarinya=girl.

question_text: A cikin nahawun Hausa, 'Kuna zuwa' tana nufin:
explanation: 'Kuna zuwa' tana nufin 'you (plural) are coming' a Turanci.

question_text: A tarihin Hausa, wane ne sarkin Kano da ya fara aikin noma da fulani?
explanation: A tarihin Hausa, Sarki Muhammadu Rumfa na Kano ne ya fara aikin noma da fulani a ƙasar Hausa.

question_text: A cikin rubutun Hausa, wane ne ya fara rubuta Hausa da rubutun Ajami?
explanation: A cikin rubutun Hausa, malaman Hausa na farko ne suka fara rubuta Hausa da rubutun Ajami (Larabci).

question_text: Kalmar Hausa 'Wata' tana nufin:
explanation: Kalmar 'Wata' tana nufin 'moon' a Turanci. Rana=sun, Tauraro=star, Gajimare=cloud.

question_text: A cikin al'adun Hausa, 'Kamun Kifi' wasa ne na:
explanation: 'Kamun Kifi' a cikin al'adun Hausa wasa ne na yara da suke yi a ruwa.

question_text: A tarihin Hausa, wace birni ce ake kira 'Birnin Usman dan Fodio'?
explanation: A tarihin Hausa, ana kiran birnin Sokoto da 'Birnin Usman dan Fodio' bayan wanda ya kafa ta.

question_text: Karin maganar Hausa 'Abin da ka ci, ka ci; abin da ka bari, ka bari' tana nufin:
explanation: Karin maganar tana nufin sanin iyakarka a cikin komai.
